label: Bar Graph
description: Canonical bar graph data-viz primitive (tight-rect geometry): vertical/horizontal, labels, presets, intro animation.

values.label: Values
values.description: Numeric data values driving the chart bars.

domain.minValue.label: Min Value
domain.minValue.description: Explicit domain minimum. Auto (0 / nice) when unset.

domain.maxValue.label: Max Value
domain.maxValue.description: Explicit domain maximum. Auto (nice max) when unset.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Value-axis domain overrides — leave unset to auto-fit to nice round numbers.

layout.orientation.label: Orientation
layout.orientation.description: Vertical bars grow up; horizontal bars grow right.

layout.gap.label: Gap
layout.gap.description: Gap between bars as a fraction of bar width (0 = flush, 1 = gap as wide as a bar).

layout.barThickness.label: Bar Thickness (px)
layout.barThickness.description: Optional fixed bar thickness in px. Bars share space evenly when unset.

layout.label: Layout
layout.description: Bar geometry: orientation, spacing, thickness, corner radius.

appearance.preset.label: Preset
appearance.preset.description: Built-in color scheme (card / bars / text / grid / axis).

appearance.barColor.label: Bar Color
appearance.barColor.description: Bar fill — a single color, or an array of per-bar colors (cycled in bar order).

baseline.label: Baseline
baseline.description: Baseline rule at the bars' anchor edge.

valueAxis.label: Value Axis
valueAxis.description: Value-axis rule at the max-value side.

valueLabels.format.label: Format
valueLabels.format.description: raw = as-is; percent = share of max; compact = 1.2k.

anim.renderMode.label: Render Mode
anim.renderMode.description: "premium" (default): bars + labels fade in — premium, but the alpha is a per-pixel geq paid on every frame of a nesting parent's whole timeline. "light": opaque grow + enable-gated label pop — no geq, composable, cheap when nested.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce Motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static frame.

anim.intro.delaySec.label: Delay (s)
anim.intro.delaySec.description: Delay before the first bar starts.

anim.intro.staggerSec.label: Stagger (s)
anim.intro.staggerSec.description: Gap between consecutive bars' start times.

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from when the namespace isn't already on ctx (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.preset.label: Preset
theme.preset.description: Producer preset/variant to request (e.g. light | dark | high-contrast for @m0saic/theming/v1; producer-defined).

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is already populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the local preset palette by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens (self-seeds when nothing is upstream). Explicit color props still win.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: draw the layout contract (bars equal-thickness, text fits its slot) instead of the chart.
